description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange w..e.f.  03.07.2017 to 09.07.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and other charges should be calculated and paid. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
